analysis: EXT_SOURCE within-age-slice Spearman and distribution analysis

trend_classification.insufficient_data: Correlation unavailable or fewer than 30 observed pairs

missing_values_policy: No imputation. Missing EXT_SOURCE values are excluded from correlation and distribution calculations.
age_slice_construction: Shared qcut boundaries calculated from the full training population, independently of TARGET.

multiple_testing.within_slice_correlations: Benjamini-Hochberg correction separately for each FEATURE x TARGET across age slices.
multiple_testing.median_vs_rho_associations: Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the six FEATURE x TARGET combinations.
multiple_testing.trend_class_tests: Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the exploratory statistical tests in the comparison output.

exploratory_analysis_note: The association between slice medians and within-slice Spearman rho uses age slices as observations, not individual customers. It is descriptive and exploratory, not causal.
